# src.store.ReconcileReport
# kaynak: src/store/indexer.py
@dataclass
class ReconcileReport:
    deep: bool
    v3: bool
    events_checked: int = 0
    events_indexed: int = 0
    events_removed: int = 0
    pending: int = 0
    pending_skipped: int = 0
    season_lists: Optional[int] = None
    seasons: List[SeasonKey] = field(default_factory=list)
    changes: Optional[int] = None
    problems: List[IndexProblem] = field(default_factory=list)
    verify: Optional['VerifyReport'] = None
    seconds: float = 0.0
    @property
    def changed(self) -> bool
